law_name: Budget for Foreign Trade (Loi de finances - rapporteur special / rapporteur du budget du commerce exterieur)
description: Served repeatedly as the National Assembly's special rapporteur (rapporteur special / rapporteur du budget) for foreign trade within the annual finance bills, scrutinising the foreign-trade and export-support budget.
significance: Made foreign trade his signature parliamentary specialty over more than two decades, a background directly relevant to his 2025 appointment as Minister-Delegate for Foreign Trade.

law_name: Agricultural budget (Loi de finances - rapporteur du budget de l'agriculture)
description: Acted as rapporteur of the agricultural budget within the Finance Committee during his 2007-2012 term, building on his earlier role as Secretary of State for Agriculture.
significance: Reinforced his agriculture and rural-affairs expertise, complementing his 2004-2005 junior-ministerial portfolio.
